title: [INT-01] Configure Establishment Rules
description:
Implementation plan task: INT-01
Source: Employee Management ADRs 001–004 implementation plan; specification accepted October 28, 2026.

Category:
Integrations

Objective:
Deliver the correct Home Location while preserving approved establishment corrections.

Detailed scope:
Configure the externally supplied Boomi decision table and source-to-LocationCode mappings for operating establishments, California remote residents, other remote workers, crossing/incomplete reporting chains and approved overrides. Apply the chosen durable correction authority and clear/precedence rules. Hold missing/conflicting mappings rather than choose a corporate default. Preserve rule/version/input evidence in the supplied native support mechanism; create no new correction store without an approved design.

Deliverable:
Configured Establishment Rules with the specified fields or behavior and local configuration checks complete.

Strict technical prerequisites:
None

Blocked status:
Blocked — requires supplied Establishment rules and correction authority; Boomi payload and identity contract.

Recommended implementer role:
Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role:
Senior Consultant

Role rationale:
Moderate source transformation and governed correction handling need Consultant judgment; the rule design itself is external.

Acceptance criteria:
The supplied decision cases produce the approved HomeLocationCode.
An approved override survives later feeds until its defined clear condition, and incomplete data is held.

Specification references:
Sections 10.1.

Assumptions and open questions:
None
